item.title: These Aren’t Extras — They’re Lifelines for Students (Letter to the Editor)
item.description: The letter writer states: "From my work with young people, I can tell you that these so-called “extras” are not – they are often a lifeline for students who may be academically vulnerable or unengaged. They are the very things that motivate these students to go to school every day." item.title: Brendan Gill Will Not Seek Reelection As County Commissioner
item.description: In an interview Friday, Gill said he decided not to run for reelection so he could spend more time with his family and focus on his public affairs business. While he had no plans to stop being an active Democrat, Gill said he would not be seeking elected office for the foreseeable future.
